New to functai? Start with [Get started](../get-started.qmd), then read
these as you need them. They follow the life of a program: write it,
choose its model, measure and improve it, ship it.

## Writing AI functions

[Anatomy of an AI function](anatomy.qmd)
: How each part of a Python function becomes part of the prompt. **Read this one first.**

[Types are the contract](types.qmd)
: Lists, records, enums, literals and pydantic models, as outputs and inputs.

[Reasoning and several outputs](outputs.qmd)
: Ask the model to think first, return several values, and get everything with `all=True`.

[Tools](tools.qmd)
: Let the model call your Python functions: lookups, searches, calculations.

[Memory](memory.qmd)
: Functions that remember the conversation.

[Programs of several functions](modules.qmd)
: `@module`: plain Python that calls AI functions, measured and saved as one program.

## Models

[Models and settings](models.qmd)
: Any provider, and the cascade: whole program, block, function, copy.

[Signing in](logins.qmd)
: Subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, xAI) and API keys.

[Prompt layouts and chat templates](layouts.qmd)
: How values are written into the prompt and read back; writing the conversation yourself.

## Measure and improve

[Evaluation](evaluation.qmd)
: Scores with intervals, every answer as a table, paired comparisons.

[Optimization](optimization.qmd)
: Improve instructions and worked examples from your examples.

[AI functions on tables](tables.qmd)
: Call a function on a column, in `mutate()` and `filter()`.

## Ship

[Saving, verifying, loading](saving.qmd)
: A program and everything it depends on, in a folder, proven to run elsewhere.

[Baking into weights you own](baking.qmd)
: Train a small model to answer a function; escalate the unsure cases.

## When things go wrong

[Inspecting calls](inspection.qmd)
: See exactly what was sent and what came back.

[When the model gets it wrong](reliability.qmd)
: Repairs, retries, provider errors and the reply cache.

[Upgrading from 0.x](upgrading.qmd)
: What changed in 1.0.
